result.summary: The page appears visually well-structured overall. Only minor issues were found: a horizontally scrollable card is clipped at the screen edge, and small delivery fee text may be hard to read.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge of the screen (Trattoria Piccol...), which is expected for a carousel but can look broken at first glance.
issues.suggestion: Add a partial peek/spacing hint or scroll indicator so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: Delivery fee text (e.g. '€0.90 delivery') and restaurant metadata under cards use small, light gray text that may have low contrast for some users.
issues.suggestion: Increase text size slightly or darken the gray color to improve readability and contrast compliance.
